key_points: Mintlify generates a search MCP server for every site automatically, exposing two tools: Search (with version/language filters) and Query docs filesystem (shell-style commands for browsing/retrieving content)
Discovery endpoint at /.well-known/mcp returns JSON with server URL, transport type, authentication method, and available servers (public + authenticated)
Additional discovery endpoints: /.well-known/mcp.json, server-card.json (tool metadata), server-cards.json
MCP resources expose skill.md files to connected agents without separate installation
Rate limits: 5,000-10,000 requests per hour per endpoint (per-user and per-site)
Supports public, authenticated (OAuth), and client credentials access modes
Built-in advantage over web search: direct source access, integrated workflow, no search noise

competitors.title: Admin Model Context Protocol (MCP) server - Mintlify Official Docs
key_points: Admin MCP gives AI tools write access: content editing, navigation restructuring, docs.json updates, pull requests, workflow management
Git branch-based session model: checkout branch → read/search/edit → view diff → save as PR

14+ tools across 4 categories: Content (read, search, edit_page, write_page), Navigation (list_nodes, create_node, update_node, move_node, delete_node), Configuration (update_config), Session (checkout, list_branches, get_session_state, diff, save, discard_session)
Hosted by Mintlify at mcp.mintlify.com, requires OAuth login
Admin MCP vs Search MCP: Admin is for team content management, Search is for end-user doc access
